Folder for the 10k US Adult Faces Database (Bainbridge, Isola and Oliva, 2013; EXTERNAL_INPUTS.md, M4).
Request it at wilmabainbridge.com/facememorability2.html and put 10kfaces.zip and 2kmemorability.zip
here. Then

    python A6a_faces_and_scenes_figS15/code/run_module.py

computes the faces half of SI Appendix, Fig. S15 and writes everything it computes per face to
derived/ in this folder. The license of the database does not allow redistribution of the images or of
anything per face, so do not share these files.
